info.title: Azure DevOps
info.description: Authentication: HTTP Basic (Personal Access Token as the password, blank username). Azure DevOps Services is Microsoft's SaaS platform for source control (Git), build/release pipelines, work item tracking, and project/team administration.

servers.description: Itential Platform Integration Models require a static server URL rather than OpenAPI server variables, so the actual organization is set per-instance instead — see the Integration Configuration section in the README.

basicAuth.description: HTTP Basic auth using a blank username and an Azure DevOps Personal Access Token (PAT) as the password.

capabilities.description: Set of capabilities this project has (version control, process template).

isDisabled.description: True if the repository is disabled.

isFork.description: True if the repository was created as a fork.

objectId.description: SHA1 hash of the object the ref points to.

comment.description: Comment or message of the commit.

name.description: Ref name being updated, e.g. refs/heads/main.
Ref name being updated, e.g. refs/heads/main.

oldObjectId.description: Current object ID the ref points to (all-zeros SHA for a new branch).

newObjectId.description: New object ID for the ref to point to.

commitId.description: SHA1 of commit item was fetched at.

content.description: File content, present when the request includes includeContent.

vote.description: Vote on a pull request: 10 approved, 5 approved with suggestions, 0 no vote, -5 waiting, -10 rejected.

sourceRefName.description: Fully-qualified source branch ref, e.g. refs/heads/feature-1.

targetRefName.description: Fully-qualified target branch ref, e.g. refs/heads/main.

status.description: active, fixed, wontFix, closed, byDesign, pending.
active, fixed, wontFix, closed, byDesign, pending.

id.description: Repository ID, or full URL for external repos.

process.description: Build process, e.g. YAML pipeline file path.

variables.description: Map of pipeline variable name to {value, allowOverride, isSecret}.

status.description: none, inProgress, completed, cancelling, postponed, notStarted, all.

sourceVersion.description: Commit/changeset the build was built from.

reason.description: manual, individualCI, batchedCI, schedule, pullRequest, etc.

parameters.description: JSON-encoded string of pipeline variable overrides.

type.description: Stage, Phase, Job, Task, Checkpoint, etc.

path.description: Path to the YAML pipeline file.
Path to the YAML pipeline file, e.g. /azure-pipelines.yml.

repositories.description: Map of repository resource name to {refName, version}.

templateParameters.description: Map of pipeline template parameter name to value.

variables.description: Map of runtime variable name to {value, isSecret}.

rev.description: Revision number of the work item.

fields.description: Map of field reference name to value, e.g. System.Title, System.State, System.WorkItemType.

op.description: add, remove, replace, move, copy, test.

query.description: Work Item Query Language (WIQL) SELECT statement.
